output.summary: The user asked whether switching to a different maker of levothyroxine at the same dose required any action. The assistant explained follow-up TSH testing 6–8 weeks after the switch, symptoms to watch for, and keeping the medication routine consistent; the user also expressed annoyance that the pharmacy had not explained the substitution and preferred staying on one brand. The user said the plan was clear and was exactly the kind of straight answer they wanted.
